research_conclusion.betting_action: KEEP Arman side prediction; prefer Over 2.5 rounds to expensive moneyline at previously supplied prices
rationale: Ruffy's clearest historical weakness is sustained pressure, takedowns, mat returns and back exposure, exactly the area Tsarukyan is best equipped to attack.
Tsarukyan has a much deeper UFC sample and has gone 10-1 since his UFC debut loss to Islam Makhachev.
Ruffy is dangerous enough on the feet that Tsarukyan should not be treated as a lock if he elects to strike at range for long stretches.
Ruffy's recent KO wins over Rafael Fiziev and Michael Chandler show genuine improvement and finishing threat.
Method disagreement remains large: baseline Arman conditional method is 41.3% DEC / 38.1% KO / 20.6% SUB, while v0.27 shadow shifts to 21.8% DEC / 46.5% KO / 31.7% SUB.
Because the side is stable but the method is not, keep Arman as the winner pick and do not promote a method bet.
